traceability.notes: Story 008.0-DEV-AUTO-FIX is fully implemented for its current scope. The require-story-annotation rule adds placeholder @story annotations via ESLint auto-fix for a range of function/method patterns, and valid-annotation-format performs conservative, suffix-only @story path normalization, both guarded by safety checks. These behaviors are thoroughly covered by tests in tests/rules/auto-fix-behavior-008.test.ts and other rule tests, all of which pass under Jest. User-facing documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md accurately describes the auto-fix capabilities and safety constraints. Requirements explicitly marked as “Not yet implemented” in the story (template configurability and selective fix toggling) are out-of-scope for this iteration and not part of the acceptance criteria, so they do not block this story; all in-scope acceptance criteria and implemented requirements are met.
